body:
Measured by the #274 round at the current `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` pin, over the declared 2M-cycle window: the AOT-compiled DMG emulator costs **267.05 Ir per emulated cycle**. The budget in `aot/k_budget.txt` is **182.1**, the result of tier 1a's read and write path work (219.4 → 194.4 → 182.1, landed 2026-09-19, each an A/B with identical emulated output). So the AOT has lost all of that work and 22% more.

The budget was deliberately NOT re-baselined (see the #274 PR), so `aot/k_oracle.sh` stays red when measured until this is explained.

Likely suspects, to be measured, not assumed: the v0.46.0 slot-storage port of `aot_rt.h`; the bool-type checks (#1637 rounds); the exact-integer bitwise rule (#299); the checked-operand sequencing (#280); the boxed census meets (#292, #275). ouroboros#314 is already held for a DMG 2M-cycle Ir measurement and may be related.

## Done when
- [ ] The regression is bisected over ouroboros commits since 2026-09-19 (with each commit's pinned EigenScript), measuring K_TOTAL with `aot/k_oracle.sh`, interleaved, n ≥ 5, and the commits responsible are named with their cost.
- [ ] Each responsible change is either recovered (K_TOTAL back within 8% of 182.1) or re-baselined in `k_budget.txt` with a line naming the commit, its measured cost, and why the cost is accepted (for example, a correctness fix with no cheaper equivalent).

— Claude (orchestrator, Claude Code)
title: AOT perf: DMG K_TOTAL regressed from 182.1 to 267.05 Ir per emulated cycle (+46.7%) since 2026-09-19
